cold_open.hook: Meta's up 5.3% on AI cloud dreams while Netflix drops 3%—the market's decided which streaming future it believes in.

markets.macro_note: Broad market flat, VIX down nearly 2%, mega-cap tech carrying the load while small-caps lag.

big_story.story_title: Meta Platforms Jumps 6% on AI Cloud Ambitions: Can It Challenge Amazon and CoreWeave?
big_story.angle: Meta's betting its cloud infrastructure play can compete with AWS and the AI-native startups—the real question is whether a social media company can actually execute on enterprise infrastructure, or if this is just Zuckerberg's latest 'we're pivoting to X' moment.

quick_hits.angle: EU says Instagram and Facebook are addictive by design—Meta now has to prove they're not, which is like asking a casino to redesign slots to be less fun.

Circle, a stablecoin issuer, just got a bank charter and stock jumped 7%—crypto's finally getting the regulatory hug it's been chasing, or this is just the beginning of a very long compliance headache.
A ransomware negotiator got convicted for helping the gang he was supposed to be negotiating against—the most on-brand cybersecurity plot twist of the year.
America's 10 most expensive states are punishing residents with inflation—spoiler: California, Massachusetts, and New York are still winning the 'where your paycheck evaporates' competition.

odd_thing.joke_angle: Taliban declares war on smartphones—the one enemy they might actually lose to, since even they probably have a WhatsApp group.

yesterday_callback.topic: Meta's building its own AI chips but the stock is down—the startup energy of a $1.3 trillion company.
yesterday_callback.fresh_take: Yesterday Meta was down on chip ambitions; today it's up 5% on the cloud play those chips are supposed to power—turns out the market cares less about the hardware than whether Zuck can actually sell compute to enterprises.

sign_off.callback_target: Meta's cloud ambitions vs. AWS—the callback to whether a social media company can actually execute on enterprise infrastructure
